svg.title: Japan at a glance
svg.desc: An editorial infographic with a stylized map locating Tokyo, Yokohama, Osaka and Nagoya; nominal GDP figures for 2015–2024; a population-composition donut using the supplied undated nationality groupings; and six destinations to visit. All artwork is vector, with no scripts, external assets or raster images.

svg.text: An island nation of cities, craft and extraordinary landscapes.

g.text: Japan lies off the eastern coast of Asia,
where the Pacific meets a long chain

food traditions and ways of life.

svg.text: From Hokkaido’s open landscapes to the cities of Honshu and the southern islands,
Japan brings together dense urban life and an enduring connection to nature. Seasonal
food, local festivals and a strong sense of place make each region feel distinct.
